thread:
Alex: Heads-up — planning to cut v1.8.0 in ~2h. I have a few PRs that need eyes and a quick changelog review before we tag: #4532 (cache ttl fix), #4550 (metrics backport), #4529 (docs). Can someone take a look? cc @Julia @Mike :eyes:

Julia: Looking now, starting with #4532. quick skim — tests failing on CI, probably a flake; will re-run.

Mike: I'll grab #4550. Do we want the backport to release-1.7 branch or straight into main then backport?

Alex: Prefer backport to release-1.7 directly so we don't risk new regressions in main. Add the `needs-backport` label and target branch release-1.7.

Ria: @Alex on #4529 I left a tiny nit in the docs about the changelog entry. Suggest we format as: "Fix: cache TTL could drop unexpectedly (affects dedupe cache)."

Sam: Re: CI on #4532 — I re-ran the pipeline, all green now. Approving. :thumbsup:

Julia: Approved #4532. Left a comment to squash the debug log line.

Mike: For #4550 I pushed a small test fix and added the release note under docs/changelog/unreleased.md: "Adds metrics backport for batcher throughput." Please verify wording?

Alex: That wording works. Can you also add an entry in the changelog checklist: ticket link and mention the backport branch?

Mike: Done — updated changelog and added `backport/release-1.7` label. Needs one more approval.

Ria: Reviewing #4550 now. Two minor nits on variable names, will request changes.

Mike: Addressed nits and pushed. Ping me when approved and I'll merge.

Julia: Quick note about tagging — after merge please create annotated tag: `git tag -a v1.8.0 -m "v1.8.0 release"` and push tag. deploy-bot will pick it up.

Alex: Re: cut process — plan: finish merges in 45m, then create tag, run smoke tests, then cut. If any backports land after tag we do a patch release.

Sam: Approved #4550 after fixes.

Mike: Merged #4550.

Ria: Approved #4529 and the changelog wording.

Alex: All core PRs approved and merged. I'll create the tag in ~10m.

deploy-bot: release-scheduler: Scheduled release job for tag v1.8.0 — smoke tests queued.

Alex: Tag pushed: `git push origin refs/tags/v1.8.0`. Running smoke now.

Sam: Smoke passed on staging. :tada:

Alex: Cutting release on prod in 15m unless anyone objects.

Julia: No objections from me.

Mike: Good to go.

Alex: OK cutting now. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. Will open a backport follow-up if any issues show up.

deploy-bot: release-runner: v1.8.0 deploy started, tracking: https://ci.redwood.example.com/builds/98765

Alex: (post) If anything regresses, please file a hotfix and tag me — we'll prioritize a patch.
